name: quandora
description: Quandora plugin for factor and strategy creation, analysis, and simulated Paper Trading.

interface.shortDescription: Use Quandora services from your agent.
interface.longDescription: Quandora supports factor research and backtesting, server-evidence analysis, cross-sectional Strategy construction and diagnosis, and confirmed simulated Paper Trading workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use Quandora Factor Mining to show public tasks.
Use Quandora Factor Mining with my custom factor idea.
Use Quandora Factor Analysis to diagnose an existing factor result.
Use Quandora Strategy Building to combine existing factors into a cross-sectional strategy.
Use Quandora Strategy Analysis to diagnose a completed strategy result.
Use Quandora Paper Trading to select an eligible source and start a simulated run after confirmation.
